==Dialogue==
:''"Psst. You must give me any authorized copies of "Turai's Story" you come across so they may be held within the [[Chantry of Secrets]]. The story of [[Turai Ossa|Turai]] is an important moment in history and must be secured and preserved for future generations. Do this for the order, and I shall grant you an antique weapon we have recovered."''
